title: Children's Online Safety Risk Calculator
metaDescription: Assess your child's online safety risk level. Get personalized recommendations for parental controls, privacy settings, and COPPA compliance.
description: Evaluate potential online risks your children face and receive tailored safety recommendations. This calculator helps parents identify vulnerabilities in their child's digital activities and provides actionable steps to enhance protection.

inputs.label: Child's Age
inputs.helpText: Different age groups face different online risks and have varying levels of digital literacy

inputs.label: Daily Screen Time (hours)
inputs.helpText: Total hours spent on devices with internet access per day

inputs.label: Uses Social Media Platforms
inputs.helpText: Including platforms like Instagram, TikTok, Snapchat, YouTube, etc.

inputs.label: Parental Control Level
inputs.helpText: Current level of parental control software or settings in use

inputs.label: Primary Device Used
inputs.helpText: The main device your child uses to access the internet

inputs.label: Primary Online Activities
inputs.helpText: What your child primarily does online

inputs.label: Has received online safety education
inputs.helpText: Child has been taught about online privacy, stranger danger, and safe browsing

outputFields.label: Overall Risk Score
outputFields.description: Your child's overall online safety risk level out of 100

outputFields.label: Risk Level
outputFields.description: Categorized risk assessment with recommended actions

outputFields.label: Priority Actions Needed
outputFields.description: Number of high-priority safety measures to implement immediately

formula: let baseRisk = 20; if (childAge === 'under-6') baseRisk = 15; else if (childAge === '6-8') baseRisk = 25; else if (childAge === '8-12') baseRisk = 35; else if (childAge === '13-15') baseRisk = 50; else if (childAge === '16-17') baseRisk = 45; baseRisk += Math.min(dailyScreenTime * 3, 25); if (socialMediaUse) baseRisk += 20; if (parentalControls === 'none') baseRisk += 25; else if (parentalControls === 'basic') baseRisk += 10; else if (parentalControls === 'moderate') baseRisk -= 5; else if (parentalControls === 'comprehensive') baseRisk -= 15; if (deviceType === 'smartphone' || deviceType === 'multiple') baseRisk += 15; else if (deviceType === 'shared-computer') baseRisk -= 10; if (onlineActivities === 'unrestricted') baseRisk += 20; else if (onlineActivities === 'social') baseRisk += 15; else if (onlineActivities === 'educational') baseRisk -= 10; if (privacyEducation) baseRisk -= 15; const riskScore = Math.max(0, Math.min(100, baseRisk)); let riskLevel = 'Low Risk'; let priorityActions = 1; if (riskScore >= 70) { riskLevel = 'High Risk'; priorityActions = 4; } else if (riskScore >= 50) { riskLevel = 'Moderate Risk'; priorityActions = 3; } else if (riskScore >= 30) { riskLevel = 'Low-Moderate Risk'; priorityActions = 2; } return { riskScore, riskLevel, priorityActions };

educational.methodology: This calculator evaluates online safety risks based on key factors including age-appropriate digital exposure, device usage patterns, parental supervision levels, and safety education. Risk scores are calculated using established child development and cybersecurity guidelines.
tips: Use Incognito Browser for family web browsing to prevent tracking and maintain privacy
Enable safe search filters on all search engines your child uses
Create separate user accounts with appropriate restrictions for each child
Regularly review and update privacy settings on all platforms your child uses
Teach children to never share personal information like full name, address, or school online
Set up content filtering at the router level to protect all devices on your network
Monitor friend lists and followers on social media platforms regularly
Use family-friendly DNS services to block inappropriate content automatically

interpretation.label: Low Risk
interpretation.description: Good safety practices in place. Continue monitoring and maintain current protections.

interpretation.label: Low-Moderate Risk
interpretation.description: Some safety measures needed. Consider additional parental controls and privacy education.

interpretation.label: Moderate Risk
interpretation.description: Several risk factors present. Implement stronger parental controls and increase supervision.

interpretation.label: High Risk
interpretation.description: Multiple serious risk factors. Immediate action needed to secure your child's online activities.
